note: Remediation prose keyed by pipeline stage. Specialists write site-specific acceptance tests today; merge-time auto-fill from acceptance_test_templates is future wiring, not current behavior.
forbidden_claims: Guaranteed rankings, citations, or specific AI-surface outcomes for any fix.
llms.txt as a discoverability, ranking, or citation factor.
FAQPage or HowTo schema as a fix (both retired for rich results; plain-HTML Q&A is the fix).
Mandatory @graph, required Wikidata/Wikipedia presence, or any specific knowledge-base entry as a defect.
Estimated or synthesized Core Web Vitals (CLS/LCP/INP numbers without field or lab measurement).
IndexNow submission as a guarantee of indexing or citation.
Word-count or BLUF-shape laws (fixed lengths, mandatory summaries) as requirements.
Training-crawler opt-out presented as a visibility fix (it governs training data, not citation).
Blended readiness scores or visibility percentages from prompt samples.

effort_defaults.small: single page or template edit, no design change
effort_defaults.medium: template or multi-page change, needs owner review
effort_defaults.large: structural change (rendering, IA, platform) with rollout risk

owner_defaults.content: copy, passages, metadata, structured data values

fix_families: Allowlist retrieval-bot user agents on public paths; keep training opt-outs as explicit policy, never as accidental blocks.
Remove noindex/nosnippet/max-snippet from decision pages; scope noarchive/nocache deliberately per surface.
Canonicalize to one origin (scheme/host/slash); fix redirect chains that drop deep paths.
Replace bot-challenge walls on public content with behavioral enforcement; verify via provider IP lists.
Link sitemap-declared decision URLs from hub pages and navigation.
acceptance_test_templates: Fetch the page as {bot_ua}: HTTP 200 with the decision fact in the first response.
Re-crawl: every sampled canonical equals its final fetch URL after normalization.

fix_families: Server-render decision facts into visible raw text; state carried only in inline payloads is partially readable at best.
Give text-bearing images real alt text; replace canvas/SVG-only figures and video-without-transcript with readable equivalents.
Use semantic tables for comparison content; keep answer passages inside single text elements.
Mirror metadata facts (prices, versions, plan names) in visible body copy.
acceptance_test_templates: With scripts disabled, the decision fact is present in view-source visible text.
The answer passage re-runs contiguous through the passages checker.

fix_families: Answer category-standard questions in self-contained passages: explicit subject, claim with units/timeframe, qualifier attached.
Keep qualifiers (tier, region, exception) in the same passage as the claim, not on another page.
Label comparison grids so plan-value pairing survives extraction; keep boilerplate out of the extraction lead.
acceptance_test_templates: The passage answers the question standalone when quoted without its page.
The qualifier appears within the same passage as the claim it scopes.

fix_families: Repair JSON-LD so every block parses and carries its type-required properties; never mark up invisible content.
Align the organization name across title, OG, H1, schema, and footer legal name; qualify ambiguous names with category, location, or legal form.
Resolve structured-vs-visible conflicts in favor of one stated fact; earn independent corroboration (listings, press, registries), never owned-social-only.
acceptance_test_templates: A validator parses every JSON-LD block with zero errors and matching visible values.
The brand name plus one qualifier appears identically in title, H1, and Organization schema.

fix_families: Reconcile cross-page contradictions (price, plan, version, hours) to one stated value with on-page scoping for genuine variants.
Align visible dates, structured dateModified, and sitemap lastmod; retire or supersede stale versions with explicit signals.
Emit honest lastmod (content-driven, never uniform build stamps).
acceptance_test_templates: The same fact quoted from any two sampled pages agrees, or the variant scoping is stated on-page.
No sampled page shows a date older than its newest visible content date.

fix_families: Publish the extractable passages competitors are cited for; unmet demand is content strategy, not a defect patch.
Correct misrepresented facts at the official source competitors quote; corroborate across independent surfaces.
Disambiguate shared names where probes resolve the wrong entity.
acceptance_test_templates: A repeat probe of the same question cites the official page with the corrected fact.
The official page states the fact the third party was cited for, verbatim quotable.

fix_families: Confirm the cited fact above the fold with its qualifier; headlines count on news-style pages.
Keep answer passages in single text runs so text-fragment landings highlight; expand collapsed answers on arrival paths.
Remove blocking overlays from citation landings; fix soft-404s to real 404s with search and navigation; preserve paths across variant redirects.
acceptance_test_templates: The confirming sentence sits within the first screenful with its qualifier attached.
A nonexistent path returns 404/410 with search and navigation, never a 200.
